blurb: The Concession Golf Club features a championship golf course designed by Jack Nicklaus and Tony Jacklin, known for hosting major golf tournaments including the Senior PGA Championship and World Golf Championships. The club emphasizes tournament conditions and a natural setting with no houses lining the course. It maintains strict club etiquette and dress codes to ensure a high-quality experience.
extraNote: A round of golf should not exceed four hours; pace of play rules apply · Smoking limited to golf course, parking areas, and exterior locker room veranda areas · Gratuities permitted to recognize exceptional service
